issue.title: HighlightsSaveKeyMonitorTests cannot compile because HighlightsSaveKeyEvent lacks the memberwise initializer
issue.description: Proposed by lander bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.land during post-start integration review (not a child phase proposal). bob-mac-capture commit 72cd721e591a02cd686af3951fcbbdb41d22f6ae, CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40107118870: Test fails compiling Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/HighlightsSaveKeyMonitorTests.swift:145-152. The commandS helper calls HighlightsSaveKeyEvent(charactersIgnoringModifiers:command:shift:option:control:isARepeat:), but Sources/BobMacCapture/HighlightsSaveKeyMonitor.swift declares only init(_ event: NSEvent) inside the struct, suppressing the synthesized memberwise initializer. Errors: extra arguments at positions 2-6 and cannot convert String to NSEvent. Add an explicit value initializer or move the NSEvent initializer into an extension, keeping the fixture and production event conversion behavior intact. Run portable-check, Mac scratch bundle/typecheck, and macOS XCTest CI; do not weaken or remove tests. Prior epic fix SHA 9759771 passed all 2966 tests, including all three capture argv regressions (run 40105623623). This later commit is by standalone agent a6 and no active epic or existing task owns its cause; all-status searches and recent-task sweep found no duplicate.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic Swift compile error: a custom initializer inside the struct suppresses the synthesized memberwise initializer used by the new tests. CI fails before any XCTest executes.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6 and checking later Mac commits. The new Highlights-save commit breaks macOS XCTest compilation after the epic fix had passed CI.

payload.entry: Fixed by batch-7 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.4, bob-mac-capture c5d560c: HighlightsSaveKeyEvent.init(_ event: NSEvent) moved into an extension, restoring the memberwise initializer the commandS helper calls; event conversion and all test assertions unchanged. Lander verified on master 569cb364 (contains c5d560c and bi's a49a08b): macOS CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40146325983 compiles every XCTest target and executes 3087 tests; HighlightsSaveKeyMonitorTests passes 4/4 (testAKeyAndFakeClockRequestOneHighlightsSaveScan, testMonitorRequiresSettingFrontmostAppAndAccessibility, testSaveOutsideLibraryDisarmsWithoutScanning, testWorkspaceChangesResyncTheMonitorWithoutPrompting) and RefsCoreTests.HighlightsSaveKeyTests 1/1. The run's two failures are unrelated, separately owned tasks bob-cli-bv and bob-cli-bw.
